title: Concerning the Light-Giver.
text:
⟨p.165⟩
67. Concerning this Illuminator. 67.
Once again he said to his disciples, at the time when he was sitting
in the midst of the gathering: 'According to the manner of the sun, the great
Illuminator: when he comes in his shining-forth, the moment when he shall
shine upon the cosmos, he habitually spreads forth his rays upon
the whole earth. When he comes again to setting, his rays
{9} indeed, and they set, without leaving a single ray
{10}. In this same manner is this which is likened to it,
⟨p.166⟩
In the icon of the flesh in which I have stood fast, I have
manifested forth in the cosmos, while all my sons themselves,
the elect, the righteous, who exist for me from region
to region, are likened to the rays of the sun. At the time when I
come forth out of the cosmos to depart for myself to the house of my men,
all the elect also who have trusted in me — I shall gather them {0}
to that place. I shall draw them to me, each one of them, in
the time of his coming forth. I shall not leave one of them in
the Darkness.
Therefore I say it to you that every-
one who loves me — let him love all my sons the
elect, the blessed; since I and they — {1} —
are one and the same. Why? Because my Wisdom is anointed in {2}
them all; the great Glorious One dwells in them all. Every-
one who shall love them, and shall be joined with them in his mercies
of life — he shall prevail with them, and be saved out of the cosmos
of darkness.
